爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 AHR008 岩田光希Iwata Mitsuki-夜幕妖精
清纯的外表下藏着致命诱惑。
她低眉浅笑，如邻家小姐般无害，却在夜色中化身妖精。
指尖轻触，呼吸交缠，反差极致。
缠绵之间，她温柔却精准地撩拨每一寸神经，让人沉沦其中，无法自拔。
那极致的魅力，像无声的陷阱，甜美又危险。
身型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink AHR008 Iwata Mitsuki-Night Fairy
Beneath her innocent appearance lies a deadly allure.
She smiles gently, seemingly harmless like a girl next door, yet transforms into a fairy in the night.
Fingertips lightly touch, breaths mingle, an extreme contrast.
In their passionate embrace, she gently yet precisely teases every nerve, drawing one in, making it impossible to escape.
That ultimate charm, like a silent trap, sweet yet dangerous.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
